name: Y2K Equalizer + Visualizer
overview: A 2000s-inspired equalizer and visualizer for Jellyfin Web.
description: Adds a ten-band equalizer and ten visualizers, including Winamp, Windows Media Player, iTunes, and 80s-inspired styles. Requires Jellyfin 12 and File Transformation.

versions.changelog: Adds seven audio-reactive visualizers, including 80s Synthwave Highway, Laser Dancefloor, and Arcade Starfield. Ten modes total, with saved selection and fullscreen support. Requires Jellyfin 12; not compatible with 10.11.x.
Fixes visualization when Jellyfin already owns the Web Audio source and adds double-click fullscreen visualization.
Adds an installable Jellyfin 12 server plugin and catalog manifest for the Y2K Equalizer + Visualizer.
